# OpenAI Thorp-shuffle preprint

This directory contains an unmodified pinned copy of the LaTeX sources for the OpenAI preprint *Optimal-order mixing of the Thorp shuffle* (26 September 2026).

- Upstream repository: `openai/math`
- Upstream commit: `fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb`
- Upstream directory: `preprints/Optimal-order-mixing-of-the-Thorp-shuffle-September-26-2026/build/`
- `main.tex` upstream blob: `4bfc10093e86ab9d132859e313598ed63f006b3b`
- `conditional-flow.tex` upstream blob: `c469ed5bbdcd412b1fd48c9a8293c312f40a1791`
- `references.tex` upstream blob: `a2dd7db6514f89c4fb64748b719ab6c5c1f349bf`
- Author shown by the upstream manuscript: **OpenAI**

The source is third-party material and is not represented as work authored by Christopher D. Long. It is redistributed under the upstream Apache License 2.0, reproduced in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE). The repository build compiles these pinned sources into `output/pdf/openai-thorp-mixing.pdf` without modifying the manuscript.

The separate program [`../../scripts/thorp_moment_audit.cpp`](../../scripts/thorp_moment_audit.cpp) was created for this research repository. It performs finite exact checks related to one physical Thorp shuffle; it is not part of the OpenAI preprint and does not prove the asymptotic mixing theorem.
